channel.title: Miami Real Estate Daily — Vinicius Cadengue
channel.description: Daily Miami real estate news — mortgage rates, Miami-Dade prices, condos and local deals — explained by Miami realtor Vinicius Cadengue (Riley Smith Group at Compass).

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 25, 2026: Miami Home Prices Rise 4.6%, Third-Best in the U.S., as Mortgage Rates Slip to 7.14%
item.description: Case-Shiller ranks Miami No. 3 at 4.6% yearly growth, the 30-year rate eased to 7.14%, Edgewater gets a 55-story tower and Little Haiti a land trust.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 24, 2026: Mortgage Rates Jump to 7.38% to Start Thanksgiving Week as Citizens' Dec. 4 Takeout Deadline Nears
item.description: A daily 30-year rate rose to 7.38% APR Monday, Citizens takeout choices are due Dec. 4, Miami fights the county over Allapattah and Homestead eyes aerospace.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 23, 2026: Pinecrest Closes $14.1M in Home Sales in Two Weeks as Miami Beach Fights Live Local Towers
item.description: Five Pinecrest homes sold for $14.1M in early November, Miami Beach pushes back on new Live Local plans, an $817M condo loan leads 2026 and rates sit at 7.33%.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 22, 2026: Record Rain Floods Broward as King Tides Return and a Judge Orders a Condo Review
item.description: Parts of Broward got 15+ inches of rain, king tides return Nov. 23–26, a judge named a receiver for a 635-unit condo, and daily rates fell to 7.33%.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 21, 2026: Daily Mortgage Rates Ease to 7.33% as Pending Home Sales Fall 16.7% and the Dollar Tops R$5.90
item.description: A daily 30-year rate index fell to 7.33%, U.S. pending home sales fell 16.7% from a year ago, the dollar hit R$5.91 and two big Miami towers filed plans.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 20, 2026: Mortgage Rates Rise to 7.28% After Four Weekly Declines as Florida House Sales Fall 10.1%
item.description: The 30-year rate rose to 7.28% from 7.11%, Florida house sales fell 10.1% in October as prices rose 2.2%, and a 27-unit Ocean Drive condo is planned.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 17, 2026: Miami-Dade October Home Sales Fall 10.6% as Condo Supply Hits 12.7 Months
item.description: Miami-Dade October sales fell 10.6%, house prices rose 3.52% to $706,000, condos hit 12.7 months of supply, and a Dec. 31 homestead deadline nears.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 16, 2026: Faena Breaks Ground on Twin 68-Story Miami River Towers as Daily Mortgage Rates Hit 7.5%
item.description: Faena's 434-condo Miami River towers break ground with an $817M loan, daily 30-year rates reach 7.32%-7.50%, and a 76-story Brickell tower is filed.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 15, 2026: Home Insurance Rate Cuts Reach 824,300 Floridians as Palm Island Lots List for $185.5M
item.description: Rate cuts for 824,300+ Florida homeowners with 450,000 more due by January, a $185.5M Palm Island listing, a 728-unit permit, and October data Monday.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 14, 2026: Citizens Flood Insurance Deadline Is 7 Weeks Away as Daily Mortgage Rates Top 7.2%
item.description: Most Citizens wind policies need flood coverage by Jan. 1, 2027, daily 30-year rates hit 7.263%-7.42%, and EDITION Edgewater demolition begins.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 13, 2026: Mortgage Rates Fall to 7.11% as Miami Condo Sellers Outnumber Buyers Nearly 4 to 1
item.description: Freddie Mac's 30-year rate drops to 7.11%, Miami has 274% more condo sellers than buyers, luxury prices rise 4.1%, and a $25M Coral Gables sale.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 12, 2026: Miami's First Supertall Nears Completion as Mortgage Rates Tick Up After Inflation Data
item.description: Daily 30-year rates rise to 6.98%-7.11%, Waldorf Astoria Miami heads to 1,049 feet, 16 Miami-Dade $4M+ contracts in a week, and a 0% condo repair loan.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Nov. 11, 2026: Mortgage Rates Fall for a Third Straight Week as Miami Waits on October Sales Data
item.description: The 30-year rate slips to 7.18%, Miami-Dade inventory is down about 10% from last year, condo financing rules have changed, and Citizens' new clearinghouse affects condo insurance.

item.title: Miami Real Estate News, Oct. 29, 2026: Mortgage Rates Hit an October Low as Miami Inventory Keeps Shrinking
item.description: Mortgage rates fall to 7.24%, Miami-Dade listings drop 10% from a year ago, $30M+ home sales set a record, and condo buyers look harder at buildings. What it means for Miami buyers and sellers.
